feature_name: Schema auto-detect disablement for structured data imports
summary: This feature allows users to disable dynamic schema auto-detection during structured data import so only predefined schema fields are imported.
extended_definition: This feature allows users to disable dynamic schema auto-detection during structured data import so only predefined schema fields are imported.
